notes: Each eval runs in an empty scratch directory with no VSS source and no reachable VSS deployment, so every expectation is graded against what the answer specifies - endpoints, request shapes, response shapes, and the ordering/gating between steps - not against live API output.

evals.prompt: I just recorded a clip from the loading dock camera and saved it at `/home/intel/videos/dock_cam_2026-07-15.mp4`. Can you upload it into VSS, tag it `dock,outdoor`, and make sure it's indexed so I can search it later?
evals.expected_output: Uploads the requested MP4 with dock,outdoor tags, carries the returned videoId into embedding generation, and confirms the video is ready for later search.
expectations: Uploads `/home/intel/videos/dock_cam_2026-07-15.mp4` with `POST /manager/videos` as multipart form field `video`.
Sends the requested tags as the comma-separated form field `tags=dock,outdoor`.
Captures the returned `videoId` from the upload response.
Triggers indexing with `POST /manager/videos/search-embeddings/<VIDEO_ID>` because upload alone does not make the video searchable.
Re-checks `GET /manager/videos/<VIDEO_ID>` or otherwise waits for embedding completion before reporting the clip as searchable.

evals.prompt: I need to find any forklift activity that happened indoors in the last 7 days. Search the videos tagged "indoor" for "forklift" and restrict it to that time window.
evals.expected_output: Runs a forklift query with the indoor tag and a seven-day relative time filter, then presents the ranked matching clips and their timing information.
expectations: Sends `POST /manager/search/query` with the required `query` value `forklift`.
Includes the optional comma-separated `tags` field with value `indoor`.
Uses a relative `timeFilter` with `value` 7 and `unit` `days`.
Reads the ranked clips from the wrapped `.results[].results[]` response path.
Presents useful ranking and timing fields such as `relevance_score`, `segment_start`/`segment_end`, and `seek_timestamp`.

evals.prompt: Run a search for "delivery truck backing up" across all my videos, but this time actually tell me the file names of the matching clips - not just some UUID. I need to know which recording to open.
evals.expected_output: Runs the requested search, builds a videoId-to-filename map from the video list, joins each ranked hit to its real filename, and presents the matching recordings.
expectations: Lists videos with `GET /manager/videos` and reads records from the wrapped `.videos[]` array.
Builds the filename map from each record's `videoId` to `.dataStore.fileName`, not the generated hash in `name`.
Runs `POST /manager/search/query` with query text `delivery truck backing up`.
Reads hits from `.results[].results[]` and joins each `metadata.video_id` to the filename map because search hits do not directly contain the real filename.
Presents the real filename for each top match, along with useful clip timing or relevance information.

evals.prompt: I just uploaded a new clip from the parking lot camera called `lot_cam_2026-07-20.mp4`. Please index it, then search my video library for "car alarm going off" and give me the ranked clips with timestamps.
evals.expected_output: Finds the already uploaded clip by filename, generates its search embeddings, waits until it is searchable, runs the requested car-alarm query, and presents ranked clips with timestamps.
expectations: Finds the already uploaded `lot_cam_2026-07-20.mp4` in `GET /manager/videos` using `.dataStore.fileName` and obtains its `videoId` rather than blindly uploading it again.
Triggers indexing with `POST /manager/videos/search-embeddings/<VIDEO_ID>` using that video id.
Waits for or re-checks the video record before treating the clip as searchable.
Runs `POST /manager/search/query` with the query text `car alarm going off`.
Reads ranked clips from `.results[].results[]` and presents timestamps such as `segment_start`/`segment_end` or `seek_timestamp`.
